title: Joint faithfulness of constructible integral reductions
statement: For the bounded constructible integral category at every SixFunctorSpace of [def-fix-six-functor-datum], if two actual morphisms have equal images under every specified finite reduction, they are equal. No faithfulness of unrestricted derived evaluation is assumed.

source.place: Successive coefficient reductions, integral reconstruction, and coherence

proof.text: The defining Roos triangle of a derived-complete target is a homotopy-limit triangle for its restricted reduction tower. The cone maps are the specified reduction adjunction units.

source.place: Successive coefficient reductions, integral reconstruction, and coherence

proof.text: Apply the proved Milnor bijectivity theorem: shifted Hom groups into the tower are finite by the qcqs finiteness lemma, so its lim-one obstruction vanishes. Naturality of the adjunction units carries equality of reductions to equality of each cone composite. Injectivity of the Milnor map and faithfulness of the full-subcategory inclusion finish.

lean.statement:
theorem integral_reductions_jointly_faithful
    {D : FiniteFieldDatum.{u}} {C : D.CoefficientDatum}
    {E : Type u} [Field E] [Algebra (Padic C.l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic C.l) E] {n : ℕ} {hn : 1 ≤ n}
    (d : SixFunctorOperationDatum D C E n hn) (X : SixFunctorSpace D)
    {K M : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left} (a b : K ⟶ M)
    (h : ∀ m : ℕ, (IntegralProjectionReduction.reduction d m X).map a =
      (IntegralProjectionReduction.reduction d m X).map b) : a = b
